families.name: MultiCLS Transformer
families.description: Several learned summary tokens collect different views of the row before prediction.

families.name: TabM / TabM-mini

extensions.name: TabM-mini (xlarge-2)
extensions.capacityNote: Same architecture and parameter count as the main-sweep TabM-mini xlarge, evaluated through a separate workflow; its improvement is not attributable to additional parameters.

scalingFitBasis.data: Main-sweep best-of-size family envelopes over six nested training fractions; the selected model size may change with data size.
scalingFitBasis.parameters: Independently fitted parameter/loss Pareto sets at full training data, using total trainable parameters. No GLM parameter-scaling exponent is reported.
scalingFitBasis.normalizedGap: Each doubling illustration normalizes its own fitted relation to an initial reducible gap of 1; the gap removed is 1 - 2^(-exponent). Values are proportions, not percentage points.
scalingFitBasis.interpretation: These are separate univariate descriptive fits, not jointly identified causal effects. Do not multiply their gap reductions to predict the result of increasing data and parameters together.
scalingFitBasis.parameterAccounting: Trainable parameters in one model instance, including its internal ensemble where applicable; not multiplied by the five independent seeds.
scalingFitBasis.totalParameterAccounting: Total parameter counts additionally include non-trainable model state. These are exposed separately from the trainable P used in the parameter-scaling fits.
scalingFitBasis.computeAccounting: Training FLOPs per epoch for one seed, as profiled; not total training cost. Five-seed ensemble training requires five times this per-epoch proxy, before allowing for differing epoch counts.

fit.interpretation: An illustrative fit to the best-achieved TabM/TabM-mini envelope, including the gigantic full-data-only extension. The floor is fitted, not a proven irreducible limit.

protocol.selection: Pointwise minimum test deviance over each family's fixed main-sweep size ladder; predictions are averaged over five independent training seeds before scoring.

limitations: One confidential motor portfolio; the fitted slopes and rankings need not transfer to other datasets or targets.
The split is IID, not a temporal deployment evaluation.
Family envelopes select configurations on test performance and are descriptive, not an unbiased deployment estimate.
Full-data-only extensions were trained only at 100%; they do not form a matched six-fraction size ladder.
Fixed expert-selected recipes were used, without a systematic hyperparameter search or a comparable GBDT sweep.
Seed-level uncertainty describes training-run variability, not uncertainty over held-out policies.
Lower frequency deviance is a statistical fit improvement; it does not directly establish profit, premium, or loss-ratio improvement.
Data and parameter exponents come from separate univariate envelope fits; their normalized gap reductions do not establish a joint causal scaling law.

source.title: Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models
source.author: Ronald Richman
source.supplementScope: A separate public French MTPL illustration; it is not the source of the proprietary-portfolio results plotted here.
source.parameterBasisNotes: The parameter-plot scripts and scaling-fit notebook use params_trainable. Several approximate counts in the paper's representative resource table align with params_total instead. The interactive size-ladder data expose trainable and total counts separately.
source.precision: CSV precision retained only after reconciliation with final manuscript values to five decimal places.
dataQualityNotes: The source leaves train_set_size blank for transformer_large at 10%; the shared nested-fraction count of 404,283 is confirmed by every populated row at that fraction.
source.privacy: Only aggregate model scores, model parameter and compute counts, training-set sizes, model configuration names and published study metadata are included. No policy records, identifiers, predictions or private filesystem paths are included.
